out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD DEBRIS IN THE BACK KITCHEN HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY AND ARE ALWAYS ACCESSIBLE.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SIGNAGE AT THE HANDSINK AT THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS HAVE SIGNAGE. EHS WILL EMAIL FACILITY SA COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS AT 48F, HALF AND HALF AT 46F, MILK AT 48F, RAW STEAK AT 48F, AND RAW CHICKEN AT 48F IN THE TWO-DOOR UPRIGHT VICTORY COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE NOT KEPT IN THIS COOLER UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR VICTORY UPRIGHT COOLER AT 46-50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OF COLD HOLDING FOODS THAT WERE OUT OF TEMPERATURE. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR ANY TCS FOODS UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED A FEW FLOOR TILES BY DISHWASHING MACHINE HEAVILY CRACKED AND ALLOWING STANDING WATER TO ACCUMULATE.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE REPAIR THE FLOOR TILES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. BREAKERS BILLIARD CAFE (Inspection Date: 08/10/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN BACK KITCHEN BLOCKED WITH A CART OF DIRTY DISHWARE AND PANS IN THE SINK BASIN AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED ITEMS FROM THE SINK BASIN/IN FRONT OF THE SINK DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED THAWING SALMON STILL IN PACKAGE AND PACKAGE DID NOT HAVE A SLIT.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC UNDERSTANDS WHEN VACUUM PACKAGED FISH IS PULLED FROM FREEZER TO THAW, THE PACKAGE SHOULD BE SLIT OR THE FISH SHOULD BE REMOVED FROM THE PACKAGE.
